description:
An Advanced Slicing Software for AM Production

ideaMaker® is optimized for use with Raise3D solutions, enabling advanced 3D printing performance with a wide range of engineering and functional materials, including FFF and DLP technology.
- Short Learning Curve needed for Successful Printing
- Easy Access to Materials
- Streamlined Software
- Improved User Experience
- Direct Model Dragging: Models can now be moved by dragging them directly in the 3D viewport without entering Move mode. Wipe towers can also be dragged directly.
- Accurate Arrange Mode: Added an "Optimization" option to the Fast/Accurate dropdown in the Position panel for auto-arrangement, based on no-fit-polygon (NFP) packing for tighter results. Assemblies (groups) and IDEX duplication/mirror modes are supported.
- Support Bridge Layers: Added a Support Bridge Layers setting (Dense Support tab). Support bridges now use the support extruder and are interleaved with sparse supports in the output order.
- Wipe and Z-Hop Enhancements: Spiral z-hop is now supported in the print end segment. Retraction during wipe is now applied per-polygon to top surfaces, bottom surfaces, and narrow solid fills.
- Preview: Added a second nozzle indicator to the gcode preview in duplication/mirror mode.
- Annealing: Added an annealing phase after printing, with annealing time included in the estimated print report.
- Nitrogen Protection during Cooling: Added an option to keep nitrogen protection enabled during the post-print cooling stage in nitrogen mode.
- Material Appearance View: Replaced Realistic View with Material Appearance View, a new surface rendering mode that uses material appearance colors for powders.
- Packing Mode Protections: Transform tools are now correctly locked according to the current packing mode; models fixed in place cannot be moved, rotated, scaled, mirrored, or laid flat, and no longer prevent other models from being selected.
